questions.q: A heterozygous tall plant (Tt) is crossed with a short plant (tt). What is the expected ratio of tall : short offspring?
questions.why: Gametes T, t × t give Tt and tt in equal numbers: 1 tall : 1 short.

options: a length of DNA that codes for a protein
an alternative form of a gene
the observable features of an organism
questions.why: An allele is an alternative form of a gene; the first option defines a gene.

options: nuclear division giving genetically identical cells
the division used for growth and repair
the division used in asexual reproduction
reduction division giving genetically different haploid cells
questions.why: Meiosis halves the chromosome number (diploid → haploid) and makes gametes; the rest describe mitosis.

questions.q: How many chromosomes are in a human sperm cell? Explain your answer.
questions.model: 23; gametes are haploid, containing a single set of chromosomes (half of the 46 in a diploid cell), because they are made by meiosis.
points: haploid / single set of chromosomes (made by meiosis)
